summary: Waiting updates start right after a run, and pages are fast as soon as new results show.

fixes.title: Waiting updates start right after a run
fixes.text: An update that waits for a long run now always starts right after the run ends, never the next night.

fixes.title: Pages are fast when new results show
fixes.text: The database upkeep that keeps pages fast runs once after the run's results are published, so pages are fast at once.

fixes.title: Short hiccups no longer stop setup or updates
fixes.text: Database upkeep, database setup and updates now retry a short network or sign-in hiccup instead of stopping. The update also finds the Support app by itself.
